Categories (conductor-adjudicated, closed m3 registry, second signing 4/5/2/1/1=13 exactly, corrected from a first-signing double-count of 60201): mapping_metadata_false (4: 60101, 61905, 64920, 64940) — the declared crosswalk narrative (MATCH_LANGSUNG or CODICE_RINUMERATO) is itself false, either a wrong-parent citation (64940: cited 53201 'Aktivitas Kurir' courier code at 76% match, true parent image-verified as 64992-2020 'Perusahaan Pembiayaan Sekunder Perumahan' — corroborated by 64940's own uraian text, verified this session, which literally names 'perusahaan pembiayaan sekunder perumahan' as an in-scope activity) or a false split/scope-preservation claim (60101: declared MATCH_LANGSUNG/1:1 self-reference is false — BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 forward p.212 shows 60101-2020 fanning into TWO 2025 codes, 60101 analog + 60103 streaming, under the 2025 analog/digital/on-demand broadcasting re-axing — corroborated by 60101's own uraian cross-reference to sibling 60102, verified this session) or a low-confidence auto-match to an unrelated code (61905: 82% match to 61992; 64920: 69% auto-match to 86902 'Aktivitas Pelayanan Kesehatan...', a health-services code wholly unrelated to international trade financing — same pattern as Lot 2's 52239); source_absent_in_vault (5: 60201, 60311, 64110, 64320, 64330) — pp28_sources cites a row the pinned PP28 corpus (21 lampiran, 11,208 pages, text-hunt) does not contain, including two divergence-rule quarantines (60311, 64110, 64330 plus 60103 — D1 CLEAN vs D5 PROBLEM, plan §3 preregistered divergence rule, same rule that flipped Lot 1's 19206 and Lot 2's 52299) and two D1-metadata/D5-source-absent splits ruled source_absent_in_vault primary by the conductor (60201, 64320: 'the PP28 pointer failure is the harm blocking any licensing basis; the metadata finding is concomitant and recorded'); illegitimate_inheritance (2: 60103, 60203) — each currently cites ONE 2020 ancestor via CODICE_RINUMERATO (60103<-60102, 60203<-60202) when BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 p.395 (reverse table, conductor by-eye read prior to lane + lane-confirmed) documents a TWO-parent merge instead (60103<-{60101,60102}, 60203<-{60201,60202}) under the same re-axing event that produced 60101's split; payload_cross_contamination (1: 61909) — per_skala rows 3-5 of 6 carry INDUSTRIAL/TRADE licensing text verified in this session by direct read of the canonical payload: row 3's kewajiban 'Menyampaikan laporan kegiatan usaha kepada Menteri Perdagangan' (report to the Ministry of TRADE) and rows 4-5's kewajiban 'Memiliki bukti penyampaan wajib Data Industri tervalidasi ... sesuai peraturan perundang-undangan di bidang perindustrian' (mandatory validated Industry Data submission under INDUSTRIAL-sector regulation) plus 'Lokasi industrinya berada...' (industrial-site location framing) — none of which corresponds to 'Aktivitas Telekomunikasi Lainnya YTDL' (other telecom activities); rows 0-2 are topically consistent telecom licensing, but the whole array is detached per the detach-all rule (no cherry-picking clean rows from a mixed-contamination array); unresolvable_source_pointer (1: 64220) — both seats returned no-category and the runner applied its #2731 retro-demote rule because the D2 self-confirmation path could not ground the pointer. Full adversarial cycle held (W100 protocol): codex sol xhigh red-team on the first-signed report returned FIX-FIRST (1 BLOCKER + 4 MAJOR, all cured in this second signing) + cross-family GLM pass scheduled before Lot 4 (not yet run at cure-authoring time, per report §6). Control protocol amended and validated this lot: both innocence controls (59140, 59201) were pre-verified BY EYE on BOTH crosswalk directions before enrollment and came back 2/2 true-clean (vs 0/2 in Lot 2) — the two initial candidates 61101/61102 were REJECTED at pre-verification (revealed as 3-parent merges) before ever reaching the lane. Compiler input for scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py — same false-friend detach pattern as Lot 1/2: per_skala -> [] + PRESERVE the contaminated/disputed block under the disputed key + corroborated _data_note + honest-gap intel_2026.whatYouNeed. NEVER authors a replacement licensing value or a replacement crosswalk-source value (rule #9 / rule #4 detach>plausible-remap, same invariant as Lot 1/2): pp28_sources is left UNCHANGED on every one of the 13 codes (including 64940, whose true parent 64992-2020 is image-verified — it is recorded as provenance inside _data_note only, NEVER injected into pp28_sources, because the compiler has no kbli_2020_source-correction field and this cure does not add one, preserving the standing never-author-new-source-values invariant rather than extending the compiler to break it). Four codes ALSO get a status_mapping/whatChanged metadata correction using an ENUM VALUE ALREADY PRESENT in the dataset (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE, used 195x elsewhere, including for self-reference-defect corrections like the 'Cleaned: removed invalid [...]' pattern already present on other records): 60101 (false MATCH_LANGSUNG split -> MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE, the closest existing enum flagging a non-trivial/non-1:1 crosswalk — no distinct split-specific enum exists in the current 4-value registry MATCH_LANGSUNG/CODICE_RINUMERATO/MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE/BPS_ONLY), 60103 and 60203 (false single-parent CODICE_RINUMERATO -> MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE, an exact fit for the verified 2-parent merge). 64940 does NOT get a status_mapping_correction: CODICE_RINUMERATO remains the correct relationship TYPE (a 1:1 renumbering) even once the source number is corrected — the defect is the cited NUMBER (53201), not the relationship SHAPE, and the compiler has no field to fix the number, so the correction is recorded narratively in _data_note only (rule #9). 61905, 64920, 60201, 60311, 64110, 64320, 64330, 61909, 64220 get NO status_mapping_correction: no independently-verified replacement value was established for these in the conductor's report (unlike 64940's image-verified 64992, or 60101/60103/60203's image-verified re-axing), so per rule #9 they are detach-only with an honest data_note, exactly as Lot 2 treated its un-replaced metadata-false and source-absent codes. pma_status / l4_bali / TKA facets are NOT touched and NOT asserted in any note (P1-v2 abstain fail-safe, plan §8 A-1, same as Lot 1/2).

The Lot 3 conductor gate (§2, D1+D5 agreement) verified BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 5 forward table p.212 BY EYE: KBLI-2020 code 60101 fans out into TWO KBLI-2025 codes, 60101 (this code, analog) and 60103 (audio distribution/streaming-on-demand), under the 2025 analog/digital/on-demand broadcasting re-axing — a genuine SPLIT, not the preserved-scope 1:1 the declared MATCH_LANGSUNG narrates. status_mapping is corrected from the false 'MATCH_LANGSUNG' to 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' — the closest ALREADY-PRESENT enum value (195 other canonical records) flagging a non-trivial crosswalk; the current 4-value registry (MATCH_LANGSUNG/CODICE_RINUMERATO/MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE/BPS_ONLY) has no distinct split-specific value, and this cure does not invent one — MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE is reused here the same way the dataset already reuses it for other self-reference-defect corrections (the 'Cleaned: removed invalid [...]' pattern present on 51 other single-source records). pp28_sources stays UNCHANGED (['60101'] — this code's own 2020 ancestor is correctly self-cited; the sibling 60103 is a co-descendant, not an additional ancestor of THIS code, so nothing is added to pp28_sources). per_skala detached; the licensing regime for analog radio broadcasting is not retrievable from the pinned sources as hunted (the served rows derive from the false unchanged-scope narrative).
